caption:
Mr Turtle barely moves from his chair, apart from lunch. He sits up straight, yet still feels stiff by mid-afternoon.

The longer you hold one position, the more stiffness can build. That's why changing position often can help more than chasing one perfect posture. Good posture is your next one!

Hybi's 30-minute rule: every half hour, stand, roll your shoulders back 5 times and gently lean back 5 times. Take calls standing.

Frequent headaches, arm or leg tingling, or no change after two weeks are worth an assessment. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio ⏰
